name: Yamanaka Jonin

entries.name: Uncanny Senses
entries.text: Immune to the surprised condition. +5 bonus to Perception (already added).

entries.name: Adept Transfer
entries.text: A creature that fails a saving throw inflicted by a Genjutsu you cast suffers a 1d4 penalty to its saving throw against the next Genjutsu you cast.

entries.name: Mental Domination
entries.text: Twice per encounter, when using Yamanaka Clan Genjutsu, you may increase the save DC by 2.

entries.name: Expert Seal Weaver
entries.tags: Attack, Defense, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff
entries.text: Twice per combat, you can cast one Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.

entries.name: Untainted Focus
entries.text: You can concentrate on up to 3 jutsu at once.

entries.name: Initial Authority
entries.text: Whenever a creature fails the saving throw to resist Mind Body Transfer or Mind Clone Technique, while in control of the creature(s), you may spend 1 Tenacity die to immediately cast 1 jutsu you know with a casting time of 1 action.

entries.name: Yamanaka Clan Passive
entries.text: This adversary is the ultimate Sensory shinobi. Jutsu this adversary casts with the Sensory keyword cannot be dispelled.

entries.name: Controller Passive 1
entries.text: Jutsu you cast that would inflict a condition of any type cannot have their saving throws (if any) made with a jutsu-based bonus that lets the target roll an additional die other than a d20 (such as Bless).

entries.name: Controller Passive 2
entries.text: Once per turn, jutsu you cast that would inflict a penalty of any type also always inflict 1 rank of Concussed.

entries.name: Controller Ability
entries.text: By spending 3 Tenacity dice and its action, this adversary can create a chakra surge. When it does, all hostile creatures within 30 feet of this adversary must make a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw (your choice) against your highest save DC. On a failure, they lose the ability to cast jutsu with their actions or bonus actions until the end of your next turn. Once you use this ability, you must spend 5 Tenacity dice to recharge it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Yamanaka Jonin may make three attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Tanto
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Elite Action
entries.text: Takes 1 Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. Regains all Elite Actions at the start of its turn.

notes: Persuasion is printed "Persausian". Mass Mind Body Disjunction is printed "Disjuction" and Lackluster Thoughts "Lacklust Thoughts". Weapon damage is printed with a "+ 0" modifier, dropped here.
